51536634.DESCRIPTION: Antagonist activity at his-tagged FZD7 transmembrane domain (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface Plasmon: Surface Plasmon Resonance. The test of binding affinity was performed at 10 °C using a Biacore T200 machine (GE Healthcare) equilibrated with running buffer (25 mM HEPES, pH 7.5, 500 mM NaCl, 2% glycerol, 0.01% LMNG, and 0.1% DMSO) and equipped with nickel-charged NTA chips. The purified, His-tagged FZD7-TMD and SMO proteins were coupled on the NTA sensor chip (GE Healthcare) to densities of >6000 resonance units. Then, the analyte compounds were tested using a 2- or 5-fold serial dilution. The response was plotted against the analyte concentration and fitted by nonlinear regression to a one-site saturation binding model (Graphpad Prism 8.1 software).
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. Validation of F7H Binding in FZD7-TMD. (A) Chemical structure of the selected hit compound F7H. (B) F7H is a potent antagonist for FZD7 in the TOPFlash assay. (C) F7H binding in FZD-TMD. K_D determined by SPR. Data are presented as the mean ± SEM of at least 3 independent experiments in triplicate.
original_paragraph.Figure 2C sensorgram data: The sensorgram in Figure 2C shows response (RU) over time (s). The x-axis ranges from 0 to 250 s. The y-axis ranges from -5 to 20 RU. The curves are labeled with concentrations: 1000 nM, 500 nM, 250 nM, 125 nM, 62.5 nM, 25 nM, and 2.5 nM. The text in the figure states: 'K_D = 0.16 ± 0.05 μM'.
